title: Causal closure of the physical fails in quantum theory

statements.text: Because the observer's choice of question is not determined by the physical state, the causal closure of the physical is not maintained in basic physics, and mind-body supervenience is not entailed by it. The difficulties of physicalism dissolve when the classical idea of the physical is replaced by the quantum one.
